t: This is the place associated with the Association of German Women Teachers in England, an association in London dating from the 19th century. It was founded by Helene Adelmann, a German pedagogue and writer who lived from 1841 to 1915. Adelmann matters here because she set the association up, bringing together German women who taught in England. I don't have more detail about its members, its meetings or where exactly it met, so I'll say no more than the material supports.
